description: This file implements the SessionServerApp class, which manages the lifecycle of a session server in the Rialto project. It includes methods for launching, configuring, and terminating session server processes, as well as socket management and startup timing. The code also contains internal functions for generating socket paths and server IDs, and handles process synchronization and cleanup.

classes.name: SessionServerApp
classes.description: Manages a session server process, including startup, configuration, socket communication, and termination within the Rialto project.

methods.name: generateServerId
methods.description: Generates a unique server ID, incrementing a static counter.

methods.name: generateSessionManagementSocketPath
methods.description: Creates a unique socket path for session management.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketPath
methods.description: Determines the socket path based on app configuration, handling full paths, socket names, or default generation.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::launch
methods.description: Initializes sockets and spawns the session server process, handling startup timing and cleanup.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::configure
methods.description: Configures the session server with application details and updates socket paths.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::isPreloaded
methods.description: Returns whether the session server is preloaded.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session server is connected by verifying the startup timer status.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getSessionManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the session management socket name.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getSessionManagementSocketPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions for the session management socket.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getClientDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the client display name.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getInitialState
methods.description: Returns the initial session server state.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getServerId
methods.description: Returns the unique server ID.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getAppName
methods.description: Returns the application name.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getAppManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the management socket file descriptor.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getMaxPlaybackSessions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playback sessions (hardcoded).

methods.name: SessionServerApp::getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players (hardcoded).

methods.name: SessionServerApp::cancelStartupTimer
methods.description: Cancels the startup timer if active.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::cancelStartupTimerInternal
methods.description: Internal method to cancel the startup timer with thread safety.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::addAppSuffixToLogFile
methods.description: Appends server ID suffix to log file environment variables for uniqueness.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::kill
methods.description: Kills the session server process if running.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::initializeSockets
methods.description: Creates a pair of UNIX domain sockets for communication.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::setupStartupTimer
methods.description: Sets up a timer to monitor server startup and handle failures.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::spawnSessionServer
methods.description: Forks and executes the session server process, handling socket duplication and process creation.

methods.name: SessionServerApp::waitForChildProcess
methods.description: Waits for the child process to exit, with a timeout and kill fallback.
